verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to per-section markdown bundles (e.g., Desktop, API). The docs are also served as .md pages, such as the AGENTS.md and when-to-use-devin.md guides, which gives agents clean, agent-oriented documentation to consume. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining or promoting llms.txt usage for agents, and independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming it.
